Author: CheesyChiz
Name: Positional Cue
Description: Rear/flank HUD and target ring with sound cues. Manual or automatic source selection. Wrath supports action countdowns; Reborn and RSR provide direction-only hints on your selected target. Requires one supported rotation plugin. Settings: /pcue.
Punchline: Positional hints from Wrath Combo, BossMod Reborn or Rotation Solver Reborn.
Changelog: Manual/automatic rotation sources, Reborn and RSR support, and independent player dot settings.
